subject: Unexpected session duplication impacted billing - follow-up and credit plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearwaterhealth.com>, billing@clearwaterhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: potential billing anomaly affecting your Sep 8-20 usage

Hi Alicia —

I wanted to flag an anomaly our billing monitors surfaced in Clearwater Health's ledger for the period Sep 8–20. Our preliminary check shows a small subset of user sessions were double-counted during a background cache replay on Sep 10, which inflated token/session counts for a handful of jobs. We ran a quick audit and attached an excerpt of the ledger rows that look duplicated (clearwater_ledger_excerpt-20270920.csv).

We’re treating this as high priority. Next steps:
- I’ve opened an investigation with eng to confirm the root cause and the full scope.
- Once validated we will compute the correct credit amount and apply a credit memo to your account.
- I’ll share a short postmortem and the timing for the credit by EOD.

I know this is disruptive — apologies for the disruption. I’ve cc’d our billing lead Marissa so we can expedite the credit flow. If you need an immediate number for your reconciliation, say so and I’ll prioritize a manual calculation.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: clearwater_ledger_excerpt-20270920.csv
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: potential billing anomaly affecting your Sep 8-20 usage

Thanks for the heads up, Priya.

Can you confirm the total dollar impact and whether any invoices have already been posted? We close this month's books on Sep 30 and need to know if we should hold payment or expect an upcoming credit. Please send the line-level evidence and the proposed credit memo.

Immediate reversal would be preferred; if you can’t do that right away, provide the exact amount so we can adjust our accruals.

–Alicia
Alicia Gomez

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Confirmed scope: the duplicated rows correspond to 3 distinct job IDs run on Sep 10 where the cache-replay loop appended the session token counts twice. I audited the raw logs and the ledger excerpt — attached internal report.

Creditable delta: 3,150 tokens (sum across affected requests) which maps to $12,450 at Clearwater's committed rate.

Notes:
- No invoices have been finalized for the period; the amounts were reflected in preliminary usage records only.
- This is a narrowly scoped bug in the caching replay path; we’ve pushed a fix to prod and added a guard to prevent double-apply for replay windows.

Marissa — please create a credit memo for $12,450 (Credit Memo CLW-4791-01) and apply it to Clearwater Health's account. Also include a short note referencing the postmortem link for their accounting team. I’ve attached a short internal confirmation file.

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@clearwaterhealth.com>, billing@clearwaterhealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: potential billing anomaly affecting your Sep 8-20 usage — credit applied

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for your patience. Per the audit we found a duplicated token count on three jobs from Sep 10 which resulted in an overstated charge of $12,450. We’ve applied a credit memo to your account: Credit Memo CLW-4791-01 for $12,450. You should see this reflected in the billing portal and on your next invoice.

Attached: credit-memo-CLW-4791.pdf (official memo) and a short postmortem draft: redwood-postmortem-session-duplication-20270921.md. The postmortem explains the cause (cache replay double-apply), remediation (guard on replay application), and our follow-ups (longer-term monitoring + monthly ledger regression tests).

If you want a one-page summary for your finance team or a call to walk through the line-by-line evidence, I’m happy to schedule 30 minutes tomorrow.

Apologies again for the inconvenience — we’ve prioritized preventing reoccurrence and will update you if any related items surface.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
